src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险并将对COVID-19防控的影响降至最低，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的重点如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、服刑人员和监狱工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园，中小学的教师和学生，囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人， 6-59 个月的儿童，特定慢性疾病患者， 6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者，孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。
bt_tgt: Given the COVID-19 global pandemic, in order to reduce the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend that seasonal influenza vaccination focus be as follows: healthcare workers, including clinicians and Nurse, public health professional, quarantine professional; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staff caring for these vulnerable groups; people working or living in places with high population density, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary schools , inmates and prison staff; other high-risk groups in flu, including adults ≥60 years old, children 6-59 months old, people with specific chronic diseases, family members and caregivers of infants <6 months old, pregnant women Or woman planning to get pregnant during flu season.

src: Children aged 6 months through 8 years require 2 doses of influenza vaccine administered a minimum of 4 weeks apart during their first season of vaccination for optimal protection.
tgt: 6个月至8岁的儿童需要在第一个接种季节至少间隔4周接种2剂流感疫苗，以达到最佳保护效果。
ref: 6 个月至 8 岁的儿童需要接种 2 剂流感疫苗，第一剂与第二剂至少间隔 4 周，以获得最佳保护。
6 个月至 8 岁的儿童需要接种 2 剂流感疫苗，第一剂与第二剂至少间隔 4 周，以获得最佳保护。
bt_tgt: Children aged 6 months to 8 years old need to receive 2 doses of influenza vaccine at least 4 weeks apart during the first vaccination season for optimal protection.

src: If they were vaccinated in 2019-2020 influenza season or a prior season, 1 dose is recommended.
tgt: 如果他们在2019-2020年流感季节或之前的流感季节接种过疫苗，建议接种1剂。
ref: 如果他们在 2019-2020 年流感季或前一季已接种疫苗，建议接种 1 剂。
如果他们在 2019-2020 年流感季或前一季已接种疫苗，建议接种 1 剂。
bt_tgt: If they were vaccinated during the 2019-2020 flu season or a previous flu season, 1 dose is recommended.

src: People more than 8 years old require 1 dose of influenza vaccine.

src: It is recommended that people receive their influenza vaccination by the end of October.

src: Influenza vaccination should be offered as soon as the vaccination is available.

bt_tgt: Once a flu vaccine is available, influenza vaccination should be provided.

src: For the people unable to be vaccinated before the end of October, influenza vaccination will continue to be offered for the whole season.
tgt: 对于无法在10月底前接种流感疫苗的人，将继续提供整个季节的流感疫苗接种。

src: Results The retention time of sevoflurane and enflurane was similar to that of ethanol and tert butanol respectively when using the J&W DB-ALC1/DB-ALC2 gas chromatographic column, and interfered with the detection of ethanol content in blood; only J&W DB-ALC1 gas chromatographic column can separate the sevoflurane and ethanol components, so as to eliminate their influence on the detection of ethanol content in blood.
tgt: 结果使用强生W DB-ALC1/DB-ALC2气相色谱柱时，七氟醚和安氟醚的保留时间分别与乙醇和叔丁醇的保留时间相似，干扰了血液中乙醇含量的检测；只有强生DB-ALC1气相色谱柱可以分离七氟醚和乙醇成分，从而消除了它们对血液中乙醇含量检测的影响。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到全球流行的COVID-19的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，尽量减少对COVID-19预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的重点是：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士，公共卫生专业人员，检疫专业人员；生活在养老院、福利院的弱势群体和照顾弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度较高的场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学师生、罪犯、监狱工作人员等；其他流感高危人群，包括成人≥60岁、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性病的人、6个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到Covid-19全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，尽量减少对Covid-19防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先次序如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员； 生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾弱势群体的工作人员； 人们在人口密度高的地方工作或停留，如幼儿园、中小学的师生、囚犯和监狱工作人员； 其他流感高危人群，包括≥ 60岁成人、6-59岁儿童、特定慢性病患者、< 6个月婴儿的家人和看护人，以及计划在流感季节怀孕的孕妇或妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

bt_tgt: Taking into account the global pandemic of Covid-19, in order to reduce the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on Covid-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priorities for seasonal influenza vaccination: medical staff, including clinicians and nurses, public health professionals, and quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staff who care for vulnerable groups; people who work or stay in places with high population density, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, prisoners, and prison staff; other high-risk groups for influenza, including adults ≥ 60 years old, children 6-59 years old, patients with specific chronic diseases, family members and caregivers of infants < 6 months old, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: Children aged 6 months through 8 years require 2 doses of influenza vaccine administered a minimum of 4 weeks apart during their first season of vaccination for optimal protection.

src: These include neovascular age-related macular degeneration (n-AMD), proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) and retinal vein occlusions (RVO).

src: Technicians and administrators of prosthodontic technology should face up to the problems and seize the opportunities, to improve the level of prosthodontic technology and train the highly educated professionals.
tgt: 口腔修复技术的技术人员和管理人员应面对问题，抓住机遇，提高口腔修复技术水平，培养受过高等教育的专业人员。

bt_tgt: Taking into account the global COVID-19 pandemic, in order to reduce the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on the prevention and control of COVID-19, we recommend the following priorities for seasonal influenza vaccination: health care workers, including clinicians and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staff who care for these vulnerable groups; people working or staying in places with high population density, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary schools, and secondary schools, prisoners, and prison staff; other high-risk groups, including adults ≥60 years old, children 6-59 months old, patients with specific chronic diseases, family members and caregivers of infants under 6 months old, and pregnant women or women planning to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19在全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对COVID-19防控的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或逗留的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、监狱的服刑人员和工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

bt_tgt: Considering the global pandemic of COVID-19, in order to reduce the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the priorities for seasonal influenza vaccination as follows: medical staff, including clinicians and nurses, public health professionals, and quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staff who care for these vulnerable groups; people who work or stay in places with high population density, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, and inmates and staff in prisons; other high-risk groups for influenza, including adults ≥ 60 years, children 6-59 months old, people with specific chronic diseases, family members and caregivers of infants < 6 months old, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: The clinical data of 27 patients with symptomatic chronic thoracolumbar osteoporotic fractures combined with kyphosis treated between June 2015 and June 2017 were retrospectively analysed.

bt_tgt: Methods The clinical data of 27 patients with symptomatic chronic thoracolumbar osteoporotic fractures combined with kyphosis who were admitted from June 2015 to June 2017 were retrospectively analyzed.

src: The incisions healed by first intention in 26 cases, and 1 incision healed after dressing change due to poor blood glucose control.

bt_tgt: In 26 cases, the original intention of the incision was healed, and in one case healed after the dressing was changed due to poor blood sugar control.

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到COVID-19全球大流行的情况，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险并将对COVID-19防控的影响降至最低，我们建议季节性流感疫苗接种的优先事项如下：卫生保健工作者，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度高的场所工作或居住的人，如幼儿园、中小学校的教师和学生、服刑人员和监狱工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括≥60岁的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、<6个月婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇或计划在流感季节怀孕的妇女。
ref: 考虑到全球 COVID-19 大流行的情势，为了降低流感病毒感染的风险，最大限度地减少对 COVID-19 预防和控制的影响，我们建议季节性流感疫苗的优先接种对象如下：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；生活在养老院或福利院的弱势群体以及照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在高人口密度场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园、中小学教师和学生、囚犯和监狱工作人员；其他高风险流感群体，包括 60 岁以上的成年人、 6-59 个月的儿童、特定慢性疾病患者、6 个月以下婴儿的家庭成员和照顾者、孕妇及计划在流感季节期间怀孕的女士。

bt_tgt: Influenza virus infection is a respiratory infectious disease that can seriously affect human health.

src: According to WHO estimation, seasonal influenza epidemics have caused an annually 3 to 5 million severe cases and 290 000 to 650 000 deaths globally.
tgt: 根据世界卫生组织的估计，季节性流感流行每年在全球造成300万至500万严重病例和29万至65万人死亡。
ref: 根据世卫组织的预估，季节性流感疫情每年在全球产生 300 万 - 500 万严重病例和 29 万 - 65 万死亡病例。

src: Especially, COVID-19 pandemic might co-circulate with other respiratory infectious diseases such as influenza in the coming winter-spring season.

src: Seasonal influenza vaccination is the most effective way to prevent influenza virus infection and complications from infection.
tgt: 季节性流感疫苗接种是预防流感病毒感染和感染并发症的最有效方法。

bt_tgt: Seasonal influenza vaccination is the most effective way to prevent influenza virus infection and infection complications.

src: Except for a few major cities, influenza vaccine is a category Ⅱ vaccine, which means influenza vaccination is voluntary, and recipients must pay for it.
tgt: 除少数大城市外，流感疫苗为Ⅱ类疫苗，这意味着流感疫苗接种是自愿的，接种者必须付费。

bt_tgt: Except for a few large cities, influenza vaccines are Class II vaccines, which means that influenza vaccination is voluntary and recipients must pay.

src: In 2018 and 2019, the China CDC issued the "Technical Guidelines for Seasonal Influenza Vaccination in China" .

bt_tgt: In 2018 and 2019, the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued the "Technical Guidelines for Seasonal Influenza Vaccination in China".

src: In the past year, new research evidences home and abroad have been published, and new seasonal influenza vaccine has been licensed in China.

src: Children aged 6 months through 8 years require 2 doses of influenza vaccine administered a minimum of 4 weeks apart during their first season of vaccination for optimal protection.

bt_tgt: Children 6 months to 8 years of age need two doses of flu vaccine, given at least 4 weeks apart during the first vaccination season, for the best protection.

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.

src: The data were obtained from the Mortality Information System of the Brazilian Ministry of Health, from 2007 to 2016, and municipal indicators were from IBGE.
tgt: Los datos se obtuvieron del Sistema de Información sobre Mortalidad del Ministerio de Salud de Brasil, de 2007 a 2016, y los indicadores municipales fueron del IBGE.
ref: Los datos se obtuvieron del Sistema de Información de Mortalidad del Ministerio de Salud de Brasil, de 2007 a 2016, y los indicadores municipales fueron del IBGE.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).
tgt: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios que se analizaron, el Banco Mundial clasificó 130 (65,66 %) correctamente y el IBGE 183 (82,06 %).
ref: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios analizados, el Banco Mundial clasificó correctamente a 130 (65,66 %) y el IBGE, a 183 (82,06 %).
bt_tgt: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).

src: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities in Paraiba state was male gender (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age from 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birthweight (44%), and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).
tgt: El perfil epidemiológico predominante de la mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales del estado de Paraiba fue el sexo masculino (57,4 %), el color marrón de la piel (61,1 %), la edad de 0 a 7 días (52,4 %), el bajo peso al nacer (44 %) y la edad gestacional inferior a 37 semanas (43,2 %).
bt_tgt: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities of the state of Paraiba was male sex (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birth weight (44%) and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).

src: Underlying cause of death was classified as avoidable death via interventions by the Brazilian Unified National Health System (65.2%).
tgt: La causa subyacente de la muerte se clasificó como muerte evitable mediante intervenciones del Sistema Nacional de Salud Unificado de Brasil (65,2 %).
ref: La causa subyacente de muerte fue clasificada como muerte evitable a través de intervenciones del Sistema Único de Salud de Brasil (65,2 %).

errors_tgt.term: Sistema Nacional de Salud Unificado de Brasil

bt_tgt: The underlying cause of death was classified as preventable death through interventions of the Brazilian Unified National Health System (65.2%).

src: Faced with the prospect of a collapsed health system due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the professionals involved in the Neonatal Screening Programme (NSP) of Catalonia had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.
tgt: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema sanitario colapsado debido a la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.
ref: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP, por sus siglas en inglés) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.

Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP, por sus siglas en inglés) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.
bt_tgt: Faced with the prospect of a collapsed health system due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the professionals involved in the Neonatal Screening Programme (NSP) of Catalonia had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient way.

src: To this end, the laboratory was reorganised by dividing the staff into groups and the spaces were redistributed.
tgt: Con este fin, el laboratorio se reorganizó dividiendo al personal en grupos y los espacios se redistribuyeron.
ref: Para ello, se reorganizó el laboratorio dividiendo al personal en grupos y se redistribuyeron los espacios.
bt_tgt: To this end, the laboratory was reorganized by dividing staff into groups and spaces were redistributed.

src: It was also necessary to modify several protocols and circuits, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low quality samples).
tgt: También fue necesario modificar varios protocolos y circuitos, especialmente para la gestión de altas tempranas de los centros de maternidad, y para la recogida de las segundas muestras necesarias (de recién nacidos con resultados no concluyentes o para muestras de baja calidad).
ref: También fue necesario modificar varios protocolos y circuitos, especialmente para la gestión de las altas tempranas de las maternidades, y para la recogida de las segundas muestras necesarias (de recién nacidos con resultados no concluyentes o de baja calidad).
bt_tgt: Several protocols and circuits also had to be modified, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low-quality samples).

src: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples at the laboratory was achieved with respect to the previous circuit.
tgt: En general, se logró una reducción del 36% en el tiempo de llegada de estas segundas muestras al laboratorio con respecto al circuito anterior.
ref: En general, se logró una reducción del 36 % en el tiempo de llegada de estas segundas muestras al laboratorio con respecto al circuito anterior.
bt_tgt: Overall, a 36% reduction was achieved in the arrival time of these second samples to the laboratory compared to the previous circuit.

src: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.
tgt: En el caso específico de la detección de fibrosis quística, la implementación de una nueva estrategia significó una reducción del 100 % en la solicitud de segundas muestras y una reducción del 70 % en la edad de diagnóstico del recién nacido.
ref: En el caso específico de la detección de fibrosis quística, la implementación de una nueva estrategia significó una reducción del 100 % en la solicitud de segundas muestras y una reducción del 70 % en la edad de diagnóstico del recién nacido.
bt_tgt: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100 % reduction in the request for second samples and a 70 % reduction in the diagnosis age of the newborn.

src: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in the professionals, in families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for the early detection of the diseases included in our programme.
tgt: Los objetivos más importantes fueron prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma efectividad para la detección precoz de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.

bt_tgt: The most important objectives were to prevent the risk of infection in professionals, families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for the early detection of diseases included in our program.

src: The present systematic review examined post-migration variables impacting upon mental health outcomes among asylum-seeking and refugee populations in Europe.
tgt: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables post-migración que afectan a los resultados de salud mental entre las poblaciones de refugiados y solicitantes de asilo en Europa.
ref: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables posteriores a la migración que afectan a los resultados de salud mental entre las poblaciones solicitantes de asilo y refugiadas en Europa.
bt_tgt: This systematic review examined the post-migration variables that affect mental health results among refugee populations and asylum seekers in Europe.

src: It focuses on the effects of post-settlement stressors (including length of asylum process and duration of stay, residency status and social integration) and their impact upon post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety and depression.
tgt: Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto sobre el trastorno por estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.
ref: Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.

src: Contrary to expectation, residency or legal status was posited as a marker for other explanatory variables, including loneliness, discrimination and communication or language problems, rather than being an explanatory variable itself.
tgt: Contrariamente a la expectativa, la residencia o el estatus legal se planteó como un marcador para otras variables explicativas, incluyendo la soledad, la discriminación y los problemas de comunicación o lenguaje, en lugar de ser una variable explicativa en sí misma.
ref: Contrariamente a lo esperado, la residencia o el estatus legal se postuló como un marcador de otras variables explicativas, incluida la soledad, la discriminación y los problemas de comunicación o lenguaje, en lugar de ser una variable explicativa en sí misma.

src: However, in line with previous findings and as hypothesised in this review, there were statistically significant correlations found between family life, family separation and mental health outcomes.
tgt: Sin embargo, en línea con los hallazgos anteriores y según la hipótesis de esta revisión, se encontraron correlaciones estadísticamente significativas entre la vida familiar, la separación familiar y los resultados de salud mental.
ref: Sin embargo, de acuerdo con hallazgos anteriores y según la hipótesis de esta revisión, se encontraron correlaciones estadísticamente significativas entre la vida familiar, la separación familiar y los resultados de salud mental.
bt_tgt: However, in line with previous findings and as hypothesized by this review, statistically significant correlations were found between family life, family separation and mental health outcomes.

src: This study aimed to identify patients eligible for a 48-h stay after colorectal resection, to provide guidance for early discharge planning.
tgt: Este estudio pretendía identificar a los pacientes aptos para una estancia de 48 horas después de la resección colorrectal, con el fin de proporcionar orientación para la planificación temprana del alta hospitalaria.
ref: Este estudio tuvo como objetivo identificar a los pacientes aptos para una estancia de 48 horas después de la resección colorrectal, a fin de proporcionar orientación para planificar el alta temprana.
bt_tgt: This study aimed to identify patients eligible for a 48-hour stay after colorectal resection, in order to provide guidance for early discharge planning.

src: A bi-institutional retrospective cohort study was undertaken of consecutive patients undergoing major elective colorectal resection for benign or malignant pathology within a comprehensive enhanced recovery pathway between 2011 and 2017.
tgt: Se realizó un estudio de cohortes retrospectivo biinstitucional de pacientes consecutivos que se sometieron a resección colorrectal electiva mayor por patología benigna o maligna dentro de una vía integral de recuperación mejorada entre 2011 y 2017.
ref: Se llevó a cabo un estudio de cohortes retrospectivo en el que participaron pacientes consecutivos de dos centros, que se sometieron a una resección colorrectal mayor programada por trastorno benigno o maligno dentro de una vía integral de recuperación aumentada entre 2011 y 2017.
bt_tgt: A study of Bijonstitutional retrospective cohorts of consecutive patients who underwent greater elective colorectual resection due to benign or malignant pathology within an integral route of improved recovery between 2011 and 2017 were conducted.

src: Overall and severe (Clavien-Dindo grade IIIb or above) postoperative complication and readmission rates were compared between patients who were discharged within 48 h and those who had hospital stay of 48 h or more.
tgt: Se compararon las tasas de complicaciones posoperatorias y de reingreso general y grave (grado IIIb o superior de Clavien-Dindo) entre los pacientes que recibieron el alta hospitalaria en las 48 horas siguientes y los que tuvieron una estancia hospitalaria de 48 horas o más.
ref: Se compararon las tasas de complicaciones postoperatorias globales e intensas (grado de Clavien-Dindo IIIb o superior) y de reingresos entre los pacientes que fueron dados de alta en 48 h y los que tuvieron una estancia hospitalaria de 48 h o superior.

errors_tgt.term: Se compararon las tasas de complicaciones posoperatorias y de reingreso general y grave (grado IIIb o superior de Clavien-Dindo)

bt_tgt: Rates of postoperative complications and overall and major readmission (Clavien-Dindo grade IIIb or higher) were compared between patients discharged from hospital within 48 hours and those with a hospital stay of 48 hours or more.

src: In these patients, outpatient colorectal surgery should be feasible on a large scale with logistical optimization.
tgt: En estos pacientes, la cirugía colorrectal ambulatoria debe ser factible a gran escala con optimización logística.
ref: En estos pacientes, la cirugía colorrectal ambulatoria debe ser factible a gran escala con una optimización logística.
bt_tgt: In these patients, outpatient colorectal surgery should be feasible on a large scale with logistical optimization.

src: Multinominal logistic regression analysis was performed to ascertain significant factors associated with a short hospital stay (less than 48 h).
tgt: Se realizó un análisis de regresión logística multinominal para determinar los factores significativos asociados a una estancia hospitalaria corta (menos de 48 h).
ref: Se llevó a cabo un análisis de regresión logística multinominal para determinar los factores significativos asociados a una estancia hospitalaria corta (inferior a 48 h).
bt_tgt: A multinomial logistic regression analysis was performed to determine significant factors associated with a short hospital stay (less than 48 h).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5 a 18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto ocular al hablar), frecuencia de la participación y de la CdV. La relación lineal entre la capacidad de respuesta y la capacidad de respuesta fue de respuesta de los pacientes.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).
bt_tgt: Caregivers of 435 children (211 female, 224 male; mean age 12 years; SD 3 years 11 months; age range 5–18 years) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependency in managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. src: The present systematic review examined post-migration variables impacting upon mental health outcomes among asylum-seeking and refugee populations in Europe.
tgt: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables post-migración que influyen en los resultados de salud mental entre poblaciones solicitantes y refugiados en Europa.
ref: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables posteriores a la migración que afectan a los resultados de salud mental entre las poblaciones solicitantes de asilo y refugiadas en Europa.
bt_tgt: This systematic review examined the post-migration variables that influence mental health results between applicants and refugees in Europe.

src: It focuses on the effects of post-settlement stressors (including length of asylum process and duration of stay, residency status and social integration) and their impact upon post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety and depression.
tgt: Se centra en los efectos de los estresores post-asentamiento (incluyendo la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estatus de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, ansiedad y depresión.
ref: Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.

Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.

src: The present systematic review examined post-migration variables impacting upon mental health outcomes among asylum-seeking and refugee populations in Europe.

src: However, in line with previous findings and as hypothesised in this review, there were statistically significant correlations found between family life, family separation and mental health outcomes.

src: Length of asylum process and duration of stay was found to be the most frequently cited factor for mental health difficulties in 9 out of 22 studies.

src: This study aimed to identify patients eligible for a 48-h stay after colorectal resection, to provide guidance for early discharge planning.

src: To investigate associations between functioning, community participation, and quality of life (QoL) and identify whether participation mediates the effects of functioning on QoL.
tgt: Investigar las asociaciones entre funcionamiento, participación comunitaria y calidad de vida (CV) e identificar si la participación media los efectos del funcionamiento sobre la CV.
ref: Investigar las asociaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación comunitaria y la calidad de vida (CdV) e identificar si la participación influye en los efectos del funcionamiento sobre la CdV.
Investigar las asociaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación comunitaria y la calidad de vida (CdV) e identificar si la participación influye en los efectos del funcionamiento sobre la CdV.
bt_tgt: To investigate the associations between functioning, community participation, and quality of life (QoL) and to identify whether participation mediates the effects of functioning on QoL.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 varones; edad media de 12años; DE 31,11 meses; rango de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).
bt_tgt: Caregivers of 435 children (211 female, 224 male; mean age 12 years; SD 31.11 months; age range 5–18 years) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. src: In this review we focused on some of these elements such as the available biomarkers, the role of enhanced transurethral resection of the bladder and the role of the molecular classification in defining prognosis and therapeutic approaches in bladder cancer patients.
tgt: En esta revisión nos centramos en algunos de estos elementos como los biomarcadores disponibles, el papel de la resección transuretral potenciada de la vejiga y el papel de la clasificación molecular en la definición del pronóstico y las aproximaciones terapéuticas en los pacientes con cáncer de vejiga.
ref: En esta revisión nos centramos en algunos de estos elementos, como los biomarcadores disponibles, el papel de la resección transuretral mejorada de la vejiga y el papel de la clasificación molecular en la definición del pronóstico y los enfoques terapéuticos en pacientes con cáncer de vejiga.

En esta revisión nos enfocamos en algunos de estos elementos, como los biomarcadores disponibles, el papel de la resección transuretral mejorada de la vejiga y el papel de la clasificación molecular en la definición del pronóstico y los abordajes terapéuticos en pacientes con cáncer de vejiga.
bt_tgt: In this review we focus on some of these elements such as the available biomarkers, the role of enhanced transurethral resection of the bladder and the role of molecular classification in defining the prognosis and therapeutic approaches in patients with bladder cancer.

src: Although several progresses have been made, at the time none of the existing biomarkers appear to be able to safely avoid the need of cystoscopy during the follow up of bladder cancer patients.
tgt: Aunque se han realizado varios avances, en el momento no parece que ninguno de los biomarcadores existentes sea capaz de evitar de forma segura la necesidad de realizar una cistoscopia durante el seguimiento de los pacientes con cáncer de vejiga.
ref: Aunque se han logrado varios progresos, en este momento ninguno de los biomarcadores existentes parece ser capaz de evitar de manera segura la necesidad de cistoscopia durante el seguimiento de los pacientes con cáncer de vejiga.

bt_tgt: Although several advances have been made, at present none of the existing biomarkers appear to be able to safely avoid the need for cystoscopy during follow-up of patients with bladder cancer.

src: Enhanced transurethral resection technique can in some cases reduce the risk of recurrence during follow up, although its impact on survival outcomes is still under debate.

src: Transurethral resection of the bladder represents a fundamental diagnostic and therapeutic step in the management of bladder cancer and these techniques can successfully improve its outcomes.

bt_tgt: Transuretral resection of the bladder represents a fundamental diagnosis and therapeutic step in the management of bladder cancer and these techniques can satisfactorily improve their results.

src: Finally, the molecular classification of the bladder cancer represents one of the most exciting novelty in this field, improving consistently the knowledge of bladder cancer.

bt_tgt: Finally, the molecular classification of bladder cancer represents one of the most interesting developments in this field, consistently improving the knowledge of bladder cancer.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto oftalmológico al hablar), frecuencia de participación y la CV. La regresión lineal entre los medios fue la gestión de la calidad de vida.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).
bt_tgt: Caregivers of 435 children (211 female, 224 male; mean age 12 years; SD 3 years 11 months; age range 5–18 years) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependency in managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression between means was used to predict management of quality of life.

src: Greater levels of impairments with poorer functioning, notably a high level of dependence, were associated with poorer QoL. Poorer QoL can be partly explained by less frequent community participation.

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.
tgt: El estudio pretendía comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (países) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, de acuerdo con el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.
ref: El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.

El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.
bt_tgt: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which best fits the reality of the territory, in addition to analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (countries) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.

src: This was an observational epidemiological study conducted in the state of Paraíba.

src: The data were obtained from the Mortality Information System of the Brazilian Ministry of Health, from 2007 to 2016, and municipal indicators were from IBGE.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).
tgt: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios que se analizaron, el Banco Mundial clasificó 130 (65,66%) correctamente, y el IBGE 183 (82,06 %).
ref: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios analizados, el Banco Mundial clasificó correctamente a 130 (65,66 %) y el IBGE, a 183 (82,06 %).
bt_tgt: The World Bank's Rurality Definition showed Kappa = 0.337, compared to the definition of the IBGE, with Kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66 %) correctly, and IBGE 183 (82.06 %).

src: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities in Paraiba state was male gender (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age from 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birthweight (44%), and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).
tgt: El perfil epidemiológico predominante de mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales del estado de Paraiba fue el sexo masculino (57,4 %), el color marrón de la piel (61,1 %), la edad de 0 a 7 días (52,4 %), el bajo peso al nacer (44 %) y la edad gestacional inferior a 37 semanas (43,2 %).
bt_tgt: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in the rural municipalities of the State of Paraiba was the male sex (57.4 %), the brown color of the skin (61.1 %), the age of 0 to 7 days (52,4 %), low birth weight (44 %) and gestational age of less than 37 weeks (43.2 %).

src: Underlying cause of death was classified as avoidable death via interventions by the Brazilian Unified National Health System (65.2%).

bt_tgt: The underlying cause of death was classified as avoidable death through interventions by the National Unified Health System of Brazil (65.2%).

src: This classification allowed studying the infant mortality profile in rural municipalities, which was similar to the overall profile, except for maternal schooling.

bt_tgt: This classification allowed studying the infant mortality profile in rural municipalities, which was similar to the general profile, except for maternal schooling.

src: The urban/rural typology adopted by the IBGE was better than the World Bank at classifying the municipalities in Paraiba state.

src: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in the professionals, in families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for the early detection of the diseases included in our programme.
tgt: Los objetivos más importantes eran prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma efectividad para la detección temprana de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.
ref: Los objetivos más importantes eran prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma eficacia para la detección precoz de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.

src: To this end, the laboratory was reorganised by dividing the staff into groups and the spaces were redistributed.
tgt: Con este fin, el laboratorio fue reorganizado dividiendo al personal en grupos y los espacios fueron redistribuidos.

src: It was also necessary to modify several protocols and circuits, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low quality samples).
tgt: También fue necesario modificar varios protocolos y circuitos, especialmente para la gestión de altas tempranas de centros de maternidad, y para la recogida de las segundas muestras necesarias (de recién nacidos con resultados no concluyentes o para muestras de baja calidad).

bt_tgt: Several protocols and circuits also had to be modified, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low-quality samples).

src: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples at the laboratory was achieved with respect to the previous circuit.
tgt: En general, se consiguió una reducción del 36% en el tiempo de llegada de estas segundas muestras al laboratorio con respecto al circuito anterior.

bt_tgt: Overall, a 36% reduction was achieved in the arrival time of these second samples to the laboratory compared to the previous circuit.

src: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.

bt_tgt: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100 % reduction in the request for second samples and a 70 % reduction in the diagnosis age of the newborn.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: Objective: the aim of this research was to explore the relationship between dietary pattern habits and compliance with screen-time guidelines in Spanish schoolchildren.
tgt: Objetivo: explorar la relación entre hábitos dietéticos y cumplimiento de pautas de tiempo de tamizaje en escolares españoles.
ref: Objetivo: el objetivo de esta investigación fue explorar la relación entre los hábitos alimentarios y el cumplimiento de las pautas de tiempo frente a la pantalla en escolares españoles.
Objetivo: explorar la relación entre los hábitos alimentarios y el cumplimiento de las pautas sobre el tiempo frente a la pantalla en niños españoles en edad escolar.
bt_tgt: Objective: To explore the relationship between dietary habits and compliance with screening time guidelines in Spanish schoolchildren.

src: Results: for boys, those who did not meet these guidelines presented lower chances of eating vegetables regularly (OR = 0.50; 95 % CI = 0.28-0.89) or more than once a day (OR = 0.43; 95 % CI = 0.22-0.85).
tgt: Resultados: para los niños, los que no cumplieron con estas pautas presentaron menores posibilidades de comer verduras con regularidad (OR = 0,50; IC 95 % = 0,28-0,89) o más de una vez al día (OR = 0,43; IC 95 % = 0,22-0,85). ).
ref: Resultados: para los niños, aquellos que no cumplieron con estas pautas presentaron menores posibilidades de comer vegetales regularmente (OR = 0,50; IC 95 % = 0,28-0,89) o más de una vez al día (OR = 0,43; IC 95 % = 0,22-0,85).

Resultados: en el caso de niños varones, los que no cumplieron estas pautas presentaron menores posibilidades de comer verduras con regularidad (OR = 0,50; IC del 95 % = 0,28-0,89) o más de una vez al día (OR = 0,43; IC del 95 % = 0,22-0,85).

Resultados: en el caso de niños varones, los que no cumplieron estas pautas presentaron menores posibilidades de comer verduras con regularidad (OR = 0,50; IC del 95 % = 0,28-0,89) o más de una vez al día (OR = 0,43; IC del 95 % = 0,22-0,85).
bt_tgt: Results: For children, those who did not meet these guidelines presented lower possibilities of eating vegetables regularly (or = 0.50; 95 % IC = 0.28-0.89) or more than once a day (or = 0.43; 95 % IC = 0.22-0.85). ).

src: In girls, it was observed that those who did not meet the guidelines presented a lower probability of eating one piece of fruit (OR = 0.43; 95 % CI = 0.19-0.99) as well as a second piece (OR = 0.22; 95 % CI = 0.22-0.81), vegetables more than once a day (OR = 0.39; 95 % CI = 0.19-0.80), fish (at least 2-3 times/week) (OR = 0.40; 95 % CI = 0.20-0.78) and nuts (at least 2 or 3 times per week) (OR = 0.46; 95 % = 0.24-0.87). Conclusion: some healthy eating patterns, such as the consumption of fruits and vegetables, appeared to be more prevalent in those children who met the international screen-time guidelines.
tgt: En las niñas, se observó que las que no cumplían las directrices presentaban una menor probabilidad de comer una pieza de fruta (OR = 0,43; IC del 95 % = 0,19-0,99), así como una segunda pieza (OR = 0,22; IC del 95 % = 0,22-0,81), verduras más de una vez al día (OR = 0,39; IC del 95 % = 0,19-0,80), pescado (al menos 2-3 veces/semana) (OR = 0,40; IC del 95 % = 0,20-0,78) y frutos secos (al menos 2 o 3 veces por semana) (OR = 0,46; IC del 95 % = 0,24-0,87). Conclusión: algunos patrones alimentarios saludables, como el consumo de frutas y verduras, parecían ser más prevalentes en los niños que cumplían las directrices internacionales sobre el tiempo frente a la pantalla.
bt_tgt: Among girls, those not meeting guidelines were less likely to eat 1 piece of fruit (OR = 0.43; 95% CI = 0.19-0.99), a second piece (OR = 0.22; 95% CI = 0.22-0.81), vegetables more than once a day (OR = 0.39; 95% CI = 0.19-0.80), fish (at least 2-3 times/week) (OR = 0.40; 95% CI = 0.20-0.78), and nuts (at least 2-3 times/week) (OR = 0.46; 95% CI = 0.24-0.87). Conclusion: Some healthy dietary patterns, such as fruit and vegetable consumption, appeared to be more prevalent in children who met international screen time guidelines.

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.

El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.

src: The method for analyzing rural/urban typologies was based on data mining, using the Apriori algorithm of association.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).

src: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities in Paraiba state was male gender (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age from 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birthweight (44%), and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre el funcionamiento, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para manejar sus necesidades personales y contacto visual limitado al hablar experimentaron una CdV más pobre. Un funcionamiento menos deteriorado se asoció con una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció con una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza del 95 %: 1,56-3,78).

src: However, despite successful use of lithium in the treatment of affective disorders for almost 40 years, the mechanisms of its therapeutic action are still poorly understood.

src: This review presents and summarizes the current literature about the use of lithium in treatment of affective disorders, as well as its effects on cellular physiology, with a separate description of the effect of this ion on the functioning of nerve tissue and ion-molecular mechanisms.
tgt: В данном обзоре представлена и обобщена современная литература об использовании лития в лечении аффективных расстройств, а также о его влиянии на клеточную физиологию, с отдельным описанием влияния этого иона на функционирование нервной ткани и ионно-молекулярные механизмы.
bt_tgt: This review presents and summarizes modern literature on the use of lithium in the treatment of affective disorders, as well as its effect on cell physiology, with a separate description of the effect of this ion on the functioning of the nervous tissue and ion-molecular mechanisms.

src: Almost all post-COVID-19 patients complain of severe fatigue, emotional lability, and sometimes have features of asthenic-neurotic, anxiety-phobic disorders and apato-abulic syndromes, which require rehabilitation measures, as well as courses of restorative neurotrophic and nootropic therapy.
tgt: Почти все пациенты, перенесшие COVID-19, жалуются на сильную усталость, эмоциональную лабильность, а иногда имеют признаки астено-невротических, тревожно-фобических расстройств и апато-абулического синдрома, требующих реабилитационных мероприятий, а также курсов восстановительной нейротрофической и ноотропной терапии.
